body:
## Approved Implementation Plan

### Sub-Tasks

| # | Description | Complexity | Phase | Dependencies |
|---|-------------|------------|-------|----------|
| 1 | Port data hooks (useRuns, useRunLog, useCostSummary) | Standard | 1 | None |
| 2 | Relocate LogViewer to shared location | Light | 1 | None |
| 3 | Build CostPerRunChart component | Light | 1 | None |
| 4 | Build RunTable component | Standard | 2 | ST1 |
| 5 | Build DeleteJobDialog + TriggerOverrideDialog | Standard | 1 | None |
| 6 | Build full JobDetailPage (overview + config + dynamic tabs + sidebar wiring) | Complex | 3 | ST1,3,4,5 |
| 7 | Build full RunLogPage (log viewer + SSE + kill button) | Standard | 2 | ST1,2 |
| 8 | Tests (16+ test cases) | Standard | 4 | All |

### Execution Phases
- **Phase 1** (parallel): ST1, ST2, ST3, ST5
- **Phase 2** (parallel): ST4, ST7
- **Phase 3**: ST6
- **Phase 4**: ST8

### Key Decisions
- LogViewer: Reuse existing dashboard/LogViewer.tsx (move to shared location)
- Chart: Custom bar chart (no Recharts dependency)
- Routing: Keep /jobs/:id/runs/:runId as standalone route; dynamic tabs navigate via React Router
- Form: Reuse existing JobForm with tabbed layout for Configuration tab
